body:
uv 0.13.9 and main lock rsa 0.9.10, pulled in by reqsign-core 3.3.2, reqsign-google 3.2.0 and reqsign-azure-storage 3.3.0 (all require rsa ^0.9.2). RUSTSEC-2023-0071 (Marvin timing side channel, CVE-2023-49092) is fixed in rsa 0.10.0, released 2026-11-08, but reqsign has not moved yet: apache/reqsign#941 bumps it and currently fails CI on the rsa 0.10 API change.

In uv the code path is only the S3/GCS/Azure endpoint signing (UV_S3_ENDPOINT_URL, UV_GCS_ENDPOINT_URL, UV_AZURE_ENDPOINT_URL), so most users never load an RSA key. Scanners still flag every uv binary, though. Could uv pick up the reqsign release once it lands? Tracking it here so downstream users have one place to watch.
title: Move to an rsa >= 0.10 (RUSTSEC-2023-0071) once reqsign supports it
